# Node

common

interface [Node](index.html)

A unit of work in a workflow graph.

Node names must be unique within a graph, since the scheduler keys on them.

Every member except [name](name.html) and [description](description.html) requires opting in to [ExperimentalWorkflowApi](../../com.google.adk.kt.annotations/-experimental-workflow-api/index.html), so implementing a node does too; those two need no opt-in because `App`, `Runner` and `InvocationContext` expose a node as stable API.
